title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora C - Sênior (Previdência, Fundos De Investimentos, Rentabilidade)
description:
Descrição da vaga


Estamos em busca de Desenvolvedores C# - SR com oportunidade de atuar em diferentes times estratégico de Fundos e Previdência , Rentabilidade e entre outros responsável por soluções críticas dentro de um projeto global de investimentos .


Você fará parte da construção e evolução de plataformas de gestão de ordens financeiras , com alto volume de transações e integrações de alta performance com parceiros internacionais . É um ambiente técnico desafiador, com foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade de código , onde decisões arquiteturais fazem diferença real no negócio.


Aqui, esperamos alguém que vá além da implementação: que contribua ativamente para a evolução técnica do time e das soluções.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir aplicações em .NET , com foco em sistemas de gestão de ordens financeiras e integrações complexas;
  • Atuar em decisões técnicas e arquiteturais, garantindo soluções robustas, escaláveis e resilientes (métodos de paralelismo, multithreading) ;
  • Assegurar a qualidade do código por meio de boas práticas (SOLID, Clean Code, DDD), testes automatizados e code reviews colaborativos ;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar integrações assíncronas utilizando RabbitMQ e/ou Kafka , com foco em performance e confiabilidade;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times multidisciplinares em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban );
  • Contribuir paraa documentação técnica , disseminação de conhecimento e fortalecimento da cultura de excelência técnica do time.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida com C#/.NET ;
  • Forte conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server e/ou Oracle) e não relacionais (MongoDB);
  • Experiência prática com mensageria (RabbitMQ e/ou Kafka);
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis e pipelines de CI/CD ;
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo, com senso de dono e foco em qualidade técnica.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em FIX Protocol ou protocolos financeiros similares;
  • Experiência comVertical Slice Architecture ;
  • Inglês intermediário para interação em contexto global;
  • Vivência em projetos do mercado financeiro , especialmente com Investimentos, Fundos ou Previdência .



Informações adicionais

Buscamos profissionais que tenham vontade de crescer, colocar a mão na massa e fazer acontecer. Vivemos um momento único, recheado de desafios e oportunidades para agregar ainda mais valor aos nossos clientes. Se você tem esse perfil e essa ambição, inscreva-se nesta vaga e junte-se a nós para construir o futuro do mercado financeiro.

Diferenciais

title: Tax Analyst
description:
Tax Analyst - Ferragamo


About the Company

Ferragamo is a globally recognized Italian luxury fashion house, specialized in high-end footwear, leather goods, ready-to-wear, silk products, eyewear, watches, and accessories. With a strong heritage of craftsmanship and innovation, Ferragamo operates worldwide in the luxury retail industry.


We are currently seeking a Tax Analyst to join our team in a multinational retail environment.


Position Summary

The Tax Analyst will focus on Linx system operations, tax routines, and support for tax processes, including participation in tax reform implementation projects.


Key Responsibilities


Tax Operations in the Linx System

  • Creation of purchase and import orders;
  • Recording and posting of tax invoices;
  • Billing and issuance of tax invoices;
  • Issuance of electronic correction letters (CC-e);
  • Maintenance andupdate of product master data (tax classification, NCM, CST, CFOP, tax rates, etc.);
  • Maintenance andparameterization of tax rules in the system;
  • Maintenance of tax tables and rates.


Tax Routines and Compliance

  • Analysis and resolution of tax and operational discrepancies;
  • Support for internal and external audits;
  • Monitoring Brazilian tax legislation and assessing operational impacts;
  • Calculation of taxes on imported services;
  • Issuance of taxpayment forms (MIT – DCTFWeb) and GNREs;
  • Support in direct and indirect tax calculations and ancillary obligations.


Projects & Process Improvement

  • Technical tax support in projects, including tax reform implementation;
  • Review and improvement of tax and operational processes;
  • Interface with accounting, logistics, operations, and IT teams;
  • Participation in system updates and automation initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluency in Portuguese is required. English and/or Spanish is desirable for collaboration within a multinational environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields;
  • Mandatory knowledge of Linx ERP system;
  • Previous experience in tax routines within retail companies;
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian tax legislation, especially indirect taxes;
  • Experience in tax or system implementation projects.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
Job Title:Finance Business Partner (Brazil)


Job Requirements：

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Accounting, or a related field
  • 3–5 years of relevant financial experience;
    candidates with experience in large trading companies, supply chain organizations, financial BP roles, financial analysis, or Brazilian tax-related work are preferred
  • Proficient in Chinese and Portuguese , both can be used as working languages


Key Responsibilities：

1.Budget Management

Support annual budget planning in line with the Group’s budgeting guidelines;
communicate budget policies and assist business units in budget preparation, target setting, and execution planning.


2.Business & Financial Analysis

Develop a deep understanding of business operations;
analyze financial and operational performance and provide actionable insights and recommendations to support management decision-making.


3.Business Partnership & Collaboration

Work closely with business teams to optimize processes and improve operational efficiency;
respond promptly to business project needs and provide financial support.


4.Process & Data Management

Collaborate across departments to streamline workflows, clarify business data logic, and drive process optimization;
align business and functional teams on data governance and reporting standards.


5.Finance & Tax Support

Manage financial and tax risks through contract review and payment approval processes;
provide professional finance and tax advice and coordinate the resolution of tax-related matters with relevant stakeholders.


6.Financial Training & Enablement

Promote and implement company financial policies and procedures;
organize financial training sessions and provide ongoing financial guidance and professional support to business teams.


岗位：财务BP（巴西）

任职要求：

1.学历本科及以上

2.工作经验：3-5年财务工作经验，有大型商贸企业或供应链管理企业财经BP、财务分析、巴西税务处理相关经验者优先。

3.语言：中文和葡语可以作为工作语言


工作内容：

1.预算管理: 按照集团年度预算编制方针，宣导并协助业务部门进行预算编制，并下达预算指标与计划;

2.经营分析: 深入了解业务，根据业务的执行情况提出合理化建议与意见;
分析财务事项，向管理团队提供及时有效的财务状况及经营状况分析;

3.业务协同: 深入业务、通过流程优化，实现业务部门工作高效运行;
快速响应业务部门的项目需求;

4.流程管理: 跨部门流程协作，厘清业务数据及流程优化;
联动业务团队和职能团队，梳理数据逻辑;

5.财税支持: 以合同审核及付款审批工作为基础，为公司把控财税风险，为部门提供财税建议，协调处理业务部门涉及的财务税务相关工作;

6.财务培训: 宣传贯彻公司相关财务制度流程，组织开展财务相关知识培训，为业务部提供财务专业支持与指导。
